facts.fact: The SDS5 states Burkina Faso adopted a new statistics law, Loi n°036-2021/AN of 6 December 2021 on the organisation and regulation of statistical activities, and uses it as the framework defining the national statistical system's mission.
facts.system: Loi n°036-2021/AN portant organisation et réglementation des activités statistiques (2021)

facts.fact: The SDS5 says three application decrees of the 2021 statistics law are available, while texts on the statistics development fund are still awaited; the decrees are undated here, so the document's own date (December 2025) is used.
facts.system: Loi n°036-2021/AN portant organisation et réglementation des activités statistiques (2021)

facts.fact: The SDS5 evaluation of 2021-2024 says the organs of the national statistics council worked satisfactorily, including granting statistical visas, which the 2021 law requires for surveys; the period is 2021-2024 and no single date is given.
facts.system: Loi n°036-2021/AN portant organisation et réglementation des activités statistiques (2021)
